title: Pure Doll Monster
summary: Princess Cologne's Normal Monster Xyz swarm build centered on Doll Happiness, Doll House, Grandpa Demetto, and Box of Friends, paired with Normal Monster starters and Rank 4, 6, and 8 Xyz bosses. Doll House and Grandpa Demetto revive 0 ATK or DEF Normal Monsters from the GY as Level 6 or Level 8 DARK monsters for high-Rank Xyz plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Doll Happiness searches Grandpa Demetto or Box of Friends on activation, then destroys a monster in your hand or field—ideally Box of Friends—to send a Doll Monster from the Deck to the GY.

Box of Friends is a Level 1 Normal Monster with 0 ATK and 0 DEF that Special Summons 2 Normal Monsters with 0 ATK or DEF and different names directly from your Deck whenever it is destroyed and sent to the GY.
Rescue Rabbit banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Doll Monster Miss Mädchen or Doll Monster Bear-Bear from the Deck, while Unexpected Dai summons 1 from the Deck onto an empty field.

summary.title: Opening: Doll Happiness + Box of Friends / Grandpa Demetto
steps: Activate Doll Happiness to search Box of Friends (or Grandpa Demetto if you already have Box of Friends), then use Doll Happiness to destroy Box of Friends in your hand and send a Doll Monster from the Deck to the GY.

Box of Friends triggers in the GY to Special Summon Doll Monster Miss Mädchen and Doll Monster Bear-Bear from the Deck, which overlay into Princess Cologne; Princess Cologne revives Box of Friends on Xyz Summon.

Normal Summon Grandpa Demetto and activate Doll House: detach materials from Princess Cologne to revive two 0 ATK/DEF Normal Monsters as Level 8 DARK monsters with Demetto (for Number 22: Zombiestein) and two more as Level 6 DARK monsters with Doll House (for Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon or Wollow, Founder of the Drudge Dragons).

summary.title: Princess Cologne & Doll House Protection
summary.text: While you control another monster, the opponent cannot target Princess Cologne for attacks or with card effects, and Doll Happiness prevents the opponent from targeting any monsters for attacks except Princess Cologne, creating an attack lock while you control another monster. At the start of the opponent's Battle Phase, Doll House can attach an opponent's attacking monster directly to Princess Cologne as Xyz Material and end the Battle Phase. Note that Doll Happiness locks your Extra Deck summons to Xyz Monsters for the turn.

summary.title: Xyz Bosses & Payoff
points: Number 22: Zombiestein (4500 ATK Rank 8 DARK Xyz made via Grandpa Demetto) sends 1 card from your hand to the GY and detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card on the opponent's field.

Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon and Wollow, Founder of the Drudge Dragons (Rank 6 DARK Xyz made via Doll House) flip Special Summoned monsters face-down or steal and banish cards from the opponent's GY.
Whenever an Xyz Monster activates an effect by detaching a Normal Monster, Grandpa Demetto triggers to destroy 1 monster the opponent controls and inflict burn damage equal to its Rank x 300.
Zombowwow floats into Box of Friends from the Deck when destroyed, and Sky Cavalry Centaurea provides non-targeting Rank 2 removal.

allow.Zombowwow: Level 2 DARK Zombie that increases its ATK by 500 when attacking and summons Box of Friends from the Deck when destroyed.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Doll Monster Miss Mädchen or Bear-Bear directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 Doll Monster Miss Mädchen or Bear-Bear from the Deck to immediately make Princess Cologne or a Rank 6 via Doll House.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the Doll House Field Spell.
allow.Number 22: Zombiestein: Rank 8 DARK Zombie Xyz summoned directly via Grandpa Demetto's effect with 4500 ATK and face-up card negation.
allow.Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon: Rank 6 Xyz summoned using two Doll Monsters turned into Level 6 DARK monsters by Doll House.
allow.Wollow, Founder of the Drudge Dragons: Rank 6 DARK Xyz summoned via Doll House that gains ATK/DEF for every card in the opponent's GY and steals cards from their GY.
allow.Sky Cavalry Centaurea: Rank 2 Xyz made with Box of Friends that bounces opposing monsters without targeting.

main: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster with 0 ATK / 0 DEF summoned from the Deck by Box of Friends, Doll House, and Grandpa Demetto.
Level 4 WIND Beast Normal Monster with 0 ATK / 0 DEF summoned from the Deck by Box of Friends, Doll House, and Grandpa Demetto.

Core starter: detaches 1 material from Princess Cologne to Special Summon up to 2 Normal Monsters with 0 ATK or DEF from your GY as Level 8 DARK monsters, and pops a monster when an Xyz activates by detaching a Normal Monster.
Level 1 LIGHT Machine with 0 ATK / 0 DEF that Special Summons 2 Normal Monsters with 0 ATK or DEF and different names directly from your Deck whenever it is destroyed and sent to the GY.
Special Summons Box of Friends from the Deck when destroyed.
Banishes itself to summon 2 copies of Miss Mädchen or Bear-Bear directly from the Deck.

Core Continuous Spell: searches Grandpa Demetto or Box of Friends on activation, protects Princess Cologne from being targeted for attacks, and destroys 1 monster in your hand/field (Box of Friends!) to send a Doll Monster from Deck to GY.

Core Field Spell: detaches 1 material from Princess Cologne to summon 2 Normal Monsters with 0 ATK/DEF from your GY as Level 6 DARK monsters, and attaches an opponent's attacking monster to Princess Cologne to end the Battle Phase.
Special Summons Miss Mädchen or Bear-Bear from the Deck to start plays.
